proof_body:
by
  intro K _ I
  have dec : ∀ f : PowerSeries K, f ≠ 0 → ∃ (n : ℕ) (u : PowerSeries K), IsUnit u ∧ f = PowerSeries.X ^ n * u := by
    intro f hf
    refine ⟨f.order.toNat, PowerSeries.Unit_of_divided_by_X_pow_order f, Units.isUnit _, ?_⟩
    rw [PowerSeries.Unit_of_divided_by_X_pow_order_nonzero hf, PowerSeries.X_pow_order_mul_divXPowOrder]
  by_cases hI : I = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hI
  right
  have hmem : ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : PowerSeries K), IsUnit u → PowerSeries.X ^ n * u ∈ I → PowerSeries.X ^ n ∈ I := by
    intro n u hu h
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hu
    have h3 := I.mul_mem_right ((v⁻¹ : (PowerSeries K)ˣ) : PowerSeries K) h
    rwa [mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, mul_one] at h3
  have hex : ∃ k : ℕ, PowerSeries.X ^ k ∈ I := by
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hf0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hI
    obtain ⟨n, u, hu, rfl⟩ := dec f hf0
    exact ⟨n, hmem n u hu hf⟩
  classical
  refine ⟨Nat.find hex, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · intro g hg
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    by_cases hg0 : g = 0
    · simp [hg0]
    obtain ⟨m, u, hu, rfl⟩ := dec g hg0
    exact Dvd.dvd.mul_right (pow_dvd_pow _ (Nat.find_min' hex (hmem m u hu hg))) _
  · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    exact Nat.find_spec hex
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (I : Ideal (PowerSeries K)), I = ⊥ ∨ ∃ n : ℕ, I = Ideal.span {PowerSeries.X ^ n}
